_readme: Optional. You do NOT need to edit this file: a rigged model saved as assets/models/<character id>.glb (e.g. assets/models/yuji.glb) is found and configured automatically. Add an entry under "models" only to override automatic choices, e.g. "yuji": { "file": "yuji.glb", "textureMax": 4096 }. Keys: file, enabled, animation ("clips"|"procedural"), clips (role -> clip name), toon, outline, heightPx, yawDeg, footIK, textureMax, lighting. See docs/CHAR3D.md.
